chapter: New York, Henderson and Charlie Johnson
title: His own compositions and why he left Johnson for Fats
summary: He wrote only a few things such as 'Yacht Club Swing' later; he stayed with Johnson about a year, around 1933-34, then left to join Fats Waller.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Did you do any writing at all at this point, Herman?
Not arrangements, no. I wrote a few things, you know. I mean composed a few things, like the 'Yacht Club Swing.'
Well this -- this was later, with Fats.
Yeah. I was thinking of this particular time. How long did you stay with Charlie at Smalls?
I've got a note here says it was around 1933, 1934 you were with him.
And this was all at Smalls Paradise? Did you go out of town with Charlie at all, or was it just -- you stayed at Smalls?
I don't remember doing any dates out of New York with Charlie. I don't remember. Maybe so. I don't --
